name: Dr Clara Lindqvist
quote: Insomnia is rarely solved by a sleeping tablet. It is usually solved by rebuilding what the bed is for.
bio: Clara's patients are often high-functioning people for whom something has quietly stopped working: sleep first, then concentration, then patience. She is a psychiatrist who prefers to start with sleep, because it can be measured and because improving it tends to make everything else easier to address.

She offers cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia, a structured, evidence-based programme usually completed over about six sessions, and works closely with Aurevia's physicians when medication is part of the picture.
background: General adult psychiatry, with further training in sleep medicine and cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia.
